executive_summary: US equity indices wrapped up their strongest week since 2022, driven by a powerful rebound in tech and AI optimism following Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia. Macro data showed strong resilience with a massive upward revision to Q3 GDP, though underlying market corrections and sector dispersion remain prevalent. We rank 8 key setups, keeping strict adherence to technical boundaries where names below both 20D/50D SMAs are capped at neutral or tactical swing ratings.
